output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to a ridiculously high value.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow in these two statements: 'require(balanceOf[_to] + _value > balanceOf[_to]);' and 'assert(balanceOf[_from] + balanceOf[_to] == previousBalances);'. This can be exploited to make the token owner extremely poor and the attacker extremely rich.
The 'burn' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to zero.
The 'balanceOfa' function has an integer overflow that allows an attacker to cause a denial of service (DoS) to the smart contract.
